settings.name_in_paper: Interactive visualization recommendation (hierarchical semi-bandit over configurations and attribute pairs)
unmapped: Hierarchical action: choose a configuration c_t then an attribute pair {x_t,y_t} among m attributes; visualization = combination
Linear models on configuration and attribute feature vectors plus a combination bias term gamma
Feedback: binary reward on the visualization; if negative, user additionally reveals feedback on configuration and attribute pair
Setting is defined only informally in the provided source (appendix only); whether the action set varies over rounds is not stated
settings.definition_quote: We consider the regret of round $t$ under four cases when the user provides negative feedback to the visualization: Like configuration $c_t$ and attribute pair $\lbrace x_t,y_t \rbrace$ ...

tuning: bias confidence radius rho_gamma = sqrt(2 ln(T)/t_gamma)

source.quote: Therefore, we can get the overall regret by summing up the regret of each case: Reg=Reg_1+Reg_3+Reg_{2,4} =O(\sqrt{Tln^3(m^2T ln(T))})

results.notes: Not stated as a formal theorem; informal derivation in the appendix combining Lemmas 1-3. Regret type (expected/pseudo) not defined precisely; uses expectations in case bounds. The paper's m is the number of attributes, renamed m_attr. The Lemmas 1-3 are intermediate technical statements and not recorded separately.
